slide4_para: Nsoromma means "child of the heavens" or "star." It represents God's watchful presence and protection over all beings.
voiceover_script: I am Nsoromma. I watch even when you feel alone. Lift your eyes and remember you are guided.

column11: I am Aya. I grow where softer things give up. Stand firm and endure.

slide4_para: Duafe means "wooden comb." It represents beauty
voiceover_script: and the importance of self-care and dignity.
column11: I am Duafe. I shape what is seen before a word is spoken. Care is how you show who you are.
